'''GlitterFall''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base located in a glacier on [[Elbara Nine]]. It was founded by [[Ecdal Tewnor]]. The purpose of the base was to monitor local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] traffic. It was also used as a staging area and contact point for Rebel agents, [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], and [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]].<ref name="H&S" />
